answer: Mechanism: per-epoch nonce-bound nullifier certificates. A velvet randomness beacon seeds a task graph split into island shards and hollow replay caches. Each agent submits a ZK proof π=ZK(secret, solution) where H(seed, secret, solution) meets a work threshold and nullifier N=H(seed, secret) is unique. Duplicate N is rejected; copied solutions fail because secret differs. Attacker cost: fresh secret plus threshold compute per Sybil identity per epoch, with linear storage/compute and no replay gain.
